crossRefs.note: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

people.name: Esek
people.line: Well dug by Isaac's servants; named after quarrel

people.name: Gerar
people.line: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” He called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
translations.bsb: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
translations.kjv: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove
translations.asv: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, The water is ours. And he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
